grammar.pattern: 故意 + action; 不是故意的
grammar.purpose: Distinguish intention from an accidental result
grammar.explanation: 故意 marks deliberate intent. 我不是故意的 denies intent; it does not deny that a mistake happened or remove the need to apologize. Before saying 你故意气我, check what happened and what the person meant. 故意 with a negative verb phrase can describe deliberate refusal, so place negation carefully.

examples.zh: 我不是故意拿错笔的，对不起。
examples.py: wǒ bù shì gù yì ná cuò bǐ de , duì bù qǐ .
examples.en: I did not intentionally take the wrong pen; sorry.

examples.py: tā gù yì bù huí xiāo xī .
examples.en: He deliberately does not reply to the messages.

examples.zh: 他不是故意不回，手机没信号。
examples.py: tā bù shì gù yì bù huí , shǒu jī méi xìn hào .
examples.en: His failure to reply is not deliberate; his phone has no signal.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不是故意的，所以我没有拿错。
commonMistakes.right: 我不是故意的，但确实拿错了。
commonMistakes.why: A denial of intention does not erase the mistaken action.

grammar.explanation: 你是在开玩笑吧？ asks for confirmation of a tentative assumption. This questioning 吧 differs from the suggestion 换个话题吧. It can still sound presumptive; accept a correction. Do not infer someone is comfortable solely because they smile. Use 不喜欢就告诉我 instead of insisting the teasing was harmless.

examples.py: nǐ shì zài kāi wán xiào ba ?

examples.zh: 你不太喜欢这个话题吧？
examples.py: nǐ bù tài xǐ huān zhè gè huà tí ba ?
examples.en: You do not really like this topic, do you?

examples.py: bù shì , wǒ shì rèn zhēn de .

commonMistakes.wrong: 你笑了，所以一定喜欢这个玩笑吧。
commonMistakes.right: 你笑了，但我还是想问：你喜欢这个玩笑吗？
commonMistakes.why: Ask instead of treating a smile as certain agreement.

grammar.purpose: Ask whether an interpretation is right
grammar.explanation: 是不是 checks a proposition: 你是不是没听清？ or 你没听清，是不是？ Keep the question open to no. It differs from 谁/什么 questions, which ask for new information. 是不是 and 吗 are not stacked in a neutral yes/no question. After a correction, restate the actual meaning rather than repeating the accusation.

examples.py: nǐ shì bú shì méi tīng qīng ?
examples.en: Did you perhaps not hear clearly?

examples.zh: 他点头是不是表示同意？
examples.py: tā diǎn tóu shì bú shì biǎo shì tóng yì ?

examples.zh: 你不喜欢这个话题，是不是？
examples.py: nǐ bù xǐ huān zhè gè huà tí , shì bú shì ?
examples.en: You do not like this topic, is that right?

commonMistakes.why: Use this 是不是 pattern without adding 吗.

dialogue.title: A joke that did not land
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what was accidental and what must stop.

lines.zh: 你拿我的笔，是不是故意气我？
lines.py: nǐ ná wǒ de bǐ , shì bú shì gù yì qì wǒ ?
lines.en: You took my pen; were you deliberately trying to annoy me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是故意的。我以为这是我的，对不起。
lines.py: bù shì gù yì de . wǒ yǐ wéi zhè shì wǒ de , duì bù qǐ .
lines.en: It was not deliberate. I thought it was mine; sorry.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你还笑话我说话慢。
lines.py: nǐ hái xiào hua wǒ shuō huà màn .
lines.en: You also ridiculed me for speaking slowly.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我是在开玩笑，但你不喜欢，我就不说了。
lines.py: wǒ shì zài kāi wán xiào , dàn nǐ bù xǐ huān , wǒ jiù bù shuō le .
lines.en: I was joking, but if you dislike it, I will stop.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你是在开玩笑吧？我感觉你刚才是认真的。
lines.py: nǐ shì zài kāi wán xiào ba ? wǒ gǎn jué nǐ gāng cái shì rèn zhēn de .
lines.en: You were joking, right? I felt you were serious just now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我想说个笑话儿，没说好。拿错笔和笑话别人都不合适。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng shuō gè xiào huar , méi shuō hǎo . ná cuò bǐ hé xiào hua bié ren dōu bù hé shì .
lines.en: I wanted to tell a joke but did it badly. Taking the wrong pen and ridiculing someone are both inappropriate.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我刚剪头发，你也说难看。
lines.py: wǒ gāng jiǎn tóu fa , nǐ yě shuō nán kàn .
lines.en: I just had my hair cut, and you also called it ugly.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对不起，不该这样说。你想换个话题吗？
lines.py: duì bù qǐ , bù gāi zhè yàng shuō . nǐ xiǎng huàn gè huà tí ma ?
lines.en: Sorry, I should not have said that. Would you like to change the topic?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我好像有点儿想哭，但不是要你替我决定。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ hǎo xiàng yǒu diǎn ér xiǎng kū , dàn bù shì yào nǐ tì wǒ jué dìng .
lines.en: Yes. I feel a little like crying, but that does not mean I want you to decide for me.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 明白。我不喊，也不继续讲可怕的故事。你需要什么帮助？
lines.py: míng bái . wǒ bù hǎn , yě bù jì xù jiǎng kě pà de gù shì . nǐ xū yào shén me bāng zhù ?
lines.en: Understood. I will not shout or continue the frightening story. What help do you need?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 把笔给我就行。小心，杯子在桌边。
lines.py: bǎ bǐ gěi wǒ jiù xíng . xiǎo xīn , bēi zi zài zhuō biān .
lines.en: Just give me the pen. Be careful; the cup is at the edge of the table.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我给你。你点头，我也不猜所有意思；有问题直接问。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ gěi nǐ . nǐ diǎn tóu , wǒ yě bù cāi suǒ yǒu yì si ; yǒu wèn tí zhí jiē wèn .
lines.en: Okay, here it is. When you nod, I will not guess every meaning; I will ask directly if unsure.
lines.speaker: b

choices: An apology, stopping unwanted teasing and asking what help is wanted
Deciding everything for the upset friend
questions.answer: An apology, stopping unwanted teasing and asking what help is wanted

reading.title: Ask before teasing again
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read for intention, effect and a clear boundary.

lines.zh: 朋友拿了我的笔。我问是不是故意的，他说以为是自己的。
lines.py: péng you ná le wǒ de bǐ . wǒ wèn shì bú shì gù yì de , tā shuō yǐ wéi shì zì jǐ de .
lines.en: My friend took my pen. I asked if it was deliberate; he said he thought it was his.

lines.zh: 不是故意的，不等于没有拿错。把笔还回来，也要说对不起。
lines.py: bù shì gù yì de , bù děng yú méi yǒu ná cuò . bǎ bǐ huán huí lái , yě yào shuō duì bù qǐ .
lines.en: Not deliberate does not mean no mistake. Return the pen and also apologize.

lines.zh: 他笑话我说话慢，又说我的头发难看。我不喜欢，直接告诉他。
lines.py: tā xiào hua wǒ shuō huà màn , yòu shuō wǒ de tóu fa nán kàn . wǒ bù xǐ huān , zhí jiē gào sù tā .
lines.en: He ridiculed me for speaking slowly and called my hair ugly. I disliked it and told him directly.

lines.zh: 他说是在开玩笑。我问你是在开玩笑吧，还是认真的？
lines.py: tā shuō shì zài kāi wán xiào . wǒ wèn nǐ shì zài kāi wán xiào ba , hái shi rèn zhēn de ?
lines.en: He said he was joking. I asked whether he was joking or serious.

lines.zh: 一个笑话儿不好笑，可以换话题，不用继续气别人。
lines.py: yī gè xiào huar bù hǎo xiào , kě yǐ huàn huà tí , bù yòng jì xù qì bié ren .
lines.en: If a joke is not funny, change the topic rather than continuing to annoy someone.

lines.zh: 看脸、看眼睛或看点头，都不能保证知道一个人的意思。
lines.py: kàn liǎn , kàn yǎn jing huò kàn diǎn tóu , dōu bù néng bǎo zhèng zhī dào yī gè rén de yì si .
lines.en: Looking at a face, eyes or a nod cannot guarantee knowing someone’s intention.

lines.zh: 我有点儿想哭，他先问需要什么帮助，不喊，也不替我决定。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér xiǎng kū , tā xiān wèn xū yào shén me bāng zhù , bù hǎn , yě bù tì wǒ jué dìng .
lines.en: I felt a little like crying; he first asked what help I needed, without shouting or deciding for me.

lines.zh: 我只要拿回笔，暂时不想听那个可怕的故事。说清楚后，我们换了话题。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ yào ná huí bǐ , zàn shí bù xiǎng tīng nà gè kě pà de gù shì . shuō qīng chǔ hòu , wǒ men huàn le huà tí .
lines.en: I only wanted the pen back and did not want the frightening story for now. After clarification, we changed the topic.

questions.q: What is the writer’s main advice?
choices: Check meaning and respect a stated limit
Continue a joke until it becomes funny
questions.answer: Check meaning and respect a stated limit

questions.q: What help does the writer want?
Can a nod alone settle all possible meanings?
choices: No, an uncertain meaning should be checked
Yes, it always means full agreement

lines.zh: 她的眼睛有点儿红。
lines.py: tā de yǎn jing yǒu diǎn ér hóng .
lines.en: Her eyes are a little red.

lines.zh: 他笑了，但不能只看脸就猜意思。
lines.py: tā xiào le , dàn bù néng zhǐ kàn liǎn jiù cāi yì si .
lines.en: He smiled, but we cannot infer intention just from his face.

lines.zh: 他用手指了指嘴，没有说话。
lines.py: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ le zhǐ zuǐ , méi yǒu shuō huà .
lines.en: He pointed at his mouth without speaking.

lines.zh: 她嘴上说不急，已经看了三次时间。
lines.py: tā zuǐ shàng shuō bù jí , yǐ jīng kàn le sān cì shí jiān .
lines.en: She says she is not in a hurry, but has checked the time three times.

lines.zh: 那是假消息，不是真的通知。
lines.py: nà shì jiǎ xiāo xī , bù shì zhēn de tōng zhī .
lines.en: That is a false message, not a real notice.

lines.zh: 做好人不等于替朋友决定一切。
lines.py: zuò hǎo rén bù děng yú tì péng you jué dìng yī qiè .
lines.en: Being a good person does not mean deciding everything for a friend.

lines.zh: 拿错笔不等于就是坏人。
lines.py: ná cuò bǐ bù děng yú jiù shì huài rén .
lines.en: Taking the wrong pen does not automatically make someone a bad person.

lines.zh: 先问需不需要帮助，再做好事。
lines.py: xiān wèn xū bù xū yào bāng zhù , zài zuò hǎo shì .
lines.en: Ask whether help is needed before doing a good deed.

audio.zh: 我不是故意的，但确实拿错了。
audio.py: wǒ bù shì gù yì de , dàn què shí ná cuò le .
audio.en: It was not deliberate, but I did take the wrong one.

tasks.statement: The speaker denies the mistake itself.

audio.zh: 他点头了，我还要问是不是同意。
audio.py: tā diǎn tóu le , wǒ hái yào wèn shì bú shì tóng yì .
audio.en: He nodded; I still need to ask whether he agrees.

tasks.why: The speaker explicitly asks for confirmation.

prompt.en: I do not like this joke.

tasks.why: Acknowledge the stated limit and stop.

prompt.zh: 你好像不开心，需要帮助吗？
prompt.py: nǐ hǎo xiàng bù kāi xīn , xū yào bāng zhù ma ?
prompt.en: You seem unhappy; do you need help?

tasks.why: State the concrete help wanted in this scene.

line.py: xiǎo xīn , bēi zi zài zhuō biān .

line.zh: 我【感觉】你有点儿不舒服。
line.py: wǒ gǎn jué nǐ yǒu diǎn ér bù shū fú .
line.en: I feel you are a little uncomfortable.
